top_signals.title: AMD Needs a Huge Outlook to Avoid Intel’s Fate as AI Fears Rise
top_signals.summary: Advanced Micro Devices Inc. is one of this year’s best-performing chip stocks, but with skepticism about artificial-intelligence spending on the rise, it could use strong results and an aggressive outlook to maintain the momentum when the firm reports earnings Tuesday afternoon.
